definitions.explanation: The bone extending from the shoulder to the base of the neck.

examples.japanese: {鎖骨|さこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{鎖骨|さこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose clothes that show off my collarbones nicely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痩|や}せていて→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧{鎖骨|さこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm thin and my collarbones are prominent.

notes:
{鎖骨|さこつ} is the collarbone (clavicle), the bone running horizontally between the shoulder and the base of the neck.

ANATOMY:
Connects the ⟦{肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}→肩甲骨：06005_kenkoukotsu⟧ (shoulder blade/scapula) to the ⟦{胸骨|きょうこつ}→胸骨：18335_kyoukotsu⟧ (breastbone/sternum). One of the most commonly fractured bones, especially in falls and sports injuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎖骨|さこつ}を⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fracture the collarbone
- {鎖骨|さこつ}が⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: to break the collarbone
- {鎖骨|さこつ}が⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: collarbones are visible/prominent
- {鎖骨|さこつ}の⟦ライン→ライン：noentry⟧: collarbone line

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese fashion and beauty culture, visible {鎖骨|さこつ} are often considered attractive. Necklines and off-shoulder designs that show the collarbones ({鎖骨|さこつ}が⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧) are popular.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{鎖|さ}→鎖：02658_kusari⟧ (chain) + ⟦{骨|こつ}→骨：02166_hone⟧ (bone) — named for the bone's chain-like shape.
